title: Rubric - Overfitting
evidence: All 30 criteria were individually checked against the prompt, gameplay_config.txt, and scene_reference.png. Every criterion grades a requirement directly traceable to these sources. Filenames (criteria 1-3) are prompt-specified. Telemetry formats (6-7) use the prompt's prescribed templates. Physics and gameplay behavior (11-15, 26) restate prompt language. Visual criteria (16-23) anchor to the reference image and config, both designated as authoritative by the prompt. Criterion 25's 'exact wording and line breaks' echoes the prompt's own phrase. Timing criteria (10, 30) carry explicit tolerances (+-10%, +-20%). Log consistency criteria (24, 27-29) check internal logic rather than mandating gold-specific values. No criterion penalizes a valid alternate implementation.
